command:
bun install --frozen-lockfile --backend=copyfile && python3 - <<'HARNESS_COMPONENT_DRIVER'
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,os,json
source=Path.cwd(); runner=source/'.cache/harness/component-capture-runner'
runner.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
kit='3eb8829322861ed86bb975cc60c63514809a02e6'
repository='/Users/danielfugere/.codex/worktrees/history-evidence-repair/harness'
prefix='packages/reports/tests/e2e/'
files=subprocess.check_output(['git','-C',repository,'ls-tree','-r','--name-only',kit,prefix],text=True).splitlines()
selected=[p for p in files if p==prefix+'explorer-shell-component-catalog.spec.ts' or p.startswith(prefix+'support/')]
for name in selected:
 p=runner/name;p.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
 p.write_bytes(subprocess.check_output(['git','-C',repository,'show',kit+':'+name]))
 if name.endswith('component-previews/previewPage.ts'):
  p.write_text(p.read_text().replace("evidence: 'screens'",'evidence: id'))
 if name.endswith('explorer-shell-component-catalog.spec.ts'):
  code=p.read_text(); measure="\t\t\tif (viewport.id === 'desktop') await profilePreview(page, unit.id);";code=code.replace(measure,'');code=code.replace('await capturePreview(page, home, unit.id, viewport.id);','await capturePreview(page, home, unit.id, viewport.id);\n'+measure);p.write_text(code)
for name in ['src','test','specification','node_modules','packages/reports/src','packages/reports/test','packages/reports/scripts','packages/reports/node_modules','packages/desktop/src','packages/desktop/tests','packages/hub/src','packages/game/src']:
 p=runner/name;p.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
 if not p.exists():p.symlink_to(source/name,target_is_directory=True)
reports=source/'packages/reports'; support=runner/prefix/'support'; build=runner/'component-build.config.ts'
aliases={'$app/navigation':str(support/'component-previews/router.svelte.ts'),'$app/state':str(support/'component-previews/router.svelte.ts'),'$app/paths':str(support/'shell/hubPaths.ts'),'$desktop':str(source/'packages/desktop/src'),'$shared':str(reports/'src/components')}
build.write_text('import {svelte} from "@sveltejs/vite-plugin-svelte"; import {buildData} from '+json.dumps(str(support/'component-previews/buildData.ts'))+'; export default async()=>({root:'+json.dumps(str(reports))+',plugins:[svelte()],define:{"process.env.NODE_ENV":JSON.stringify("production"),__COMPONENT_PREVIEW_DATA__:JSON.stringify(await buildData())},resolve:{alias:'+json.dumps(aliases)+'},publicDir:false,logLevel:"warn",build:{outDir:'+json.dumps(str(reports/'output/shell-fixture/catalog'))+',emptyOutDir:true,cssCodeSplit:false,lib:{entry:'+json.dumps(str(support/'shell/catalogEntry.ts'))+',formats:["iife"],name:"SourceComponentCapture",fileName:"page"}}});')
config=runner/'component-test.config.ts'
config.write_text('export default {testDir:'+json.dumps(str(runner/prefix))+',testMatch:["explorer-shell-component-catalog.spec.ts"],workers:1,outputDir:'+json.dumps(str(reports/'test-results/source-component-capture'))+',use:{screenshot:"only-on-failure"},reporter:"list"};')
print('External component capture driver',kit,'over unchanged selected source',os.environ.get('HARNESS_VERIFY_REVISION'),flush=True)
logfile=Path('/tmp/harness-selected-components-'+os.environ.get('HARNESS_VERIFY_REVISION','unknown')+'.log')
for package in ['reports','desktop','hub']:
 prepared=subprocess.run(['bun','x','svelte-kit','sync'],cwd=source/'packages'/package,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,text=True)
 with logfile.open('a')as output:output.write(prepared.stdout)
 if prepared.returncode:print(prepared.stdout,flush=True);raise SystemExit(prepared.returncode)
compiled=subprocess.run(['bun','x','vite','build','--config',str(build)],cwd=reports,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,text=True)
logfile.write_text(compiled.stdout);print(compiled.stdout,flush=True)
if compiled.returncode:raise SystemExit(compiled.returncode)
environment={**os.environ,'HARNESS_VERIFY':'1'}
args=['bun','x','playwright','test','--config',str(config)]
if os.environ.get('HARNESS_COMPONENT_CAPTURE_FILTER'):args+=['--grep',os.environ['HARNESS_COMPONENT_CAPTURE_FILTER']]
run=subprocess.run(args,cwd=reports,env=environment,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,text=True)
with logfile.open("a")as output:output.write(run.stdout)
print(run.stdout,flush=True)
raise SystemExit(run.returncode)
